title: Worktree State Check Triggers
description: Which RPC methods open a new project requiring a worktree prompt.
body: WORKTREE_TRIGGERS holds home/new-project, home/open-project, home/open-recent, and home/initialize-project. The home/close-project and home/forget-recent methods never open anything. home/worktree-create is dispatched by WorktreeDialog itself rather than through run.
